_note: I054: note corrections found while writing docs/code/save-and-load.md. (1) The fifth row of the file select is the text 'Erase record' (SaveSlotMenuText; its cursor cell $05CA is TitleMenuCursorOffsets[4]), so 'probably erase' (OQ-I024-5) becomes a statement; the erase overwrites word 0 of the main and the backup block, which makes both checksums fail. (2) The failed load (carry set) is a new game: the walkthrough says 'Opt for an empty file to begin' (01-in-the-beginning.md), so 'inferred' goes. (3) There is no 'Continue' row in the file select: the notes of lib_save_system said 'after Continue'. (4) DrawSaveSlotMenu fills the name field with five word loads whose last word overlaps the fourth, so the field is nine bytes ($0447-$044F), not eight. (5) EnterFileSelect is reached after Start reloads the title scene (file_select_request = 1), not when the player 'chooses to load'. (6) HandleFileSelectChoice: the game starts on the arrival tile of the shrine, or of the first shrine for an empty slot.
